meta.title: Workspace browser
meta.description: Open an isolated Chromium window for a DSH workspace.

sessionWorkspaceMissing: Open a session in a registered workspace to use the browser.
sessionWorkspaceChanged: This session’s workspace changed while Chromium was starting. Try again.
leaveBrowser: Press Shift+Escape to return to the browser controls.
starting: Starting Chromium. The first launch may take a few minutes to import the image.
runnerUnavailable: Chromium stopped. Open it again to reconnect.
dockerCliMissing: Docker was not found. Install Docker Desktop on Windows or Docker Engine on Linux, then retry.
dockerConfigInvalid: The browser’s Docker configuration is invalid. Check the executable and seccomp paths in the plugin settings.
dockerEngineUnavailable: Cannot reach a compatible local Docker engine. Start Docker in Linux container mode and check that DSH can access it, then retry.
runnerBundleInvalid: The Chromium image is missing or damaged. Reinstall the complete Workspace Browser plugin bundle.
runnerImageLoadFailed: Docker could not import the bundled Chromium image. Check free disk space and Docker status, then retry.
runnerIsolationFailed: The Chromium runtime did not pass its required isolation checks. Ask your administrator to check Docker’s security policy.
runnerProfileInUse: Another container is using this workspace’s browser profile. Close that browser or wait for it to stop, then retry.
runnerProfileRecoveryFailed: Chromium’s leftover profile locks could not be cleared safely. Ask your administrator to investigate without deleting the browser profile volume.
runnerDisplayFailed: The Chromium display could not start. Retry; if it still fails, report this error to your administrator.
runnerStartFailed: Chromium could not start. Retry; if it still fails, report this error to your administrator.
runnerStartTimeout: Chromium took too long to start. Retry after Docker has finished starting.
localDshRequired: Open Workspace Browser from local DSH Web or the main DSH Desktop window. Remote Web is not supported.
pluginUnavailable: The browser plugin is stopping. After it restarts, reload DSH and try again.
browserBusy: The workspace browser is busy. Try again shortly.
signIn: Sign in to DSH on this computer, then try again.
handshakeFailed: The browser display could not connect.
handshakeTimeout: The browser display did not connect in time.
requestFailed: The browser service could not complete the request.
providerDisabled: The browser agent provider is disabled.
providerConflict: Another browser agent provider is active.
noSessions: This workspace has no sessions that can be selected.
grantHelp: Allow one session to request actions on one exact origin. You must approve each request before it runs.
invalidOrigin: Enter an exact HTTP(S) origin, for example https://example.com, without a path or port.
